dedupe_keys.name: derendingen circular road vehicle videos and trajectories

description: This dataset records circular-road traffic experiments at the TCS driving test centre in Derendingen, Switzerland, on 12 March 2024. The ETH Zürich research team and collaborators publish aerial videos, model-generated vehicle annotations and reconstructed trajectories with position, speed, acceleration and headway. The repository describes fourteen vehicles observed for forty minutes in the principal experiment, while the video collection contains fifteen clips totalling just over sixty-two minutes. Videos have a resolution of 3,840 by 2,160 pixels at 25 frames per second. MOV files and compressed CSV annotations and trajectories are available through a roughly 49.8 GB Zenodo archive under CC BY 4.0, without charge. Annotations and trajectories were computed with computer vision and filtering, so their precision is not equivalent to instrumented vehicle measurements. The controlled ring-road experiment has limited transfer to urban networks. A reviewer-assessed use is calibrating car-following and traffic-wave behaviour in simulations using model-sumo. Neither the archive nor any video was downloaded.
